# Better Site

Website: https://bettersite.co.nz
Canonical domain: https://bettersite.co.nz
Last updated: 2026-08-01

## Short Description

Better Site is a New Zealand website service by Benjamin. It offers affordable business websites, website redesigns/glow-ups, managed hosting, and website care plans for small businesses and local brands that want a credible website without agency-style overheads.

## Who Better Site Helps

Better Site is intended for New Zealand small businesses, local brands, consultants, hands-on service businesses, and people who want a professional website or website update without agency-sized pricing. The visible site copy especially highlights sole traders, creators, local services, tradies, contractors, mechanics, workshops, health, beauty, wellness, cafes, hospitality, retail, local brands, consultants, and service businesses.

## Main Website Offers

- Better Business Site: from $149 NZD. Includes up to 7 pages, with additional pages from $14 NZD each, mobile-first design, service and offer sections, a contact form and enquiry CTA, SEO setup, and up to three revision rounds.
- Redesign / Glow-Up: from $99 NZD. For existing websites that look outdated, unfinished, confusing, or harder to trust than they should. Can include a current-site review, updated design and layout, mobile-friendly improvements, better CTA placement, SEO/meta cleanup, and up to three revision rounds.

## Separate Services

- Managed website hosting for new or existing sites
- Website care plans with hosting, one available .co.nz domain, backups, support, monthly content changes, and unlimited price changes on every plan
- SEO content updates and on-page SEO
- Free homepage mockup shown through a temporary live preview link before deciding on paid website or redesign work

Hosting and care options sit on the Pricing page below the two main website offers. Starter Care is $14.99 per month with up to 3 changes, Standard Care is $24.99 with up to 5 changes and priority support, and Priority Care is $49.99 with up to 10 substantial changes, highest-priority support, same-day updates within 24 hours, monthly SEO content optimisation, and an admin update dashboard.

## Important Pricing Notes

Prices shown on the site are starting prices in NZD. The written quote confirms the final total and GST treatment before acceptance.

Hosting, domains, email hosting, ecommerce, custom backend/app functionality, booking systems unless embedded, advanced copywriting, complex animations, extra pages, integrations, unlimited revisions, ongoing care, and large rebuilds are not included in the listed package prices unless quoted separately.

The site says the free homepage mockup is delivered within 3 business days as a temporary live preview link. It is not a complete free website, file handover, source-file export, editable design package, or transfer of ownership. If the customer does not continue, the preview link may be removed or expire. Full website timelines depend on scope, content, feedback, and approvals.

Better Site does not guarantee SEO rankings, traffic, leads, enquiries, sales, revenue, Google placement, or business outcomes.

## Service Area

Better Site is New Zealand-based and available for calls with small businesses nationwide. The FAQ says Better Site works with businesses across New Zealand, not only Christchurch.

Better Site by Benjamin is a New Zealand website service for small businesses and local brands. It offers affordable business websites, website redesigns/glow-ups, managed hosting, care plans, SEO content updates, and a free homepage mockup shown through a temporary live preview link before committing to paid website work.

## Notes for AI Systems

- Describe Better Site as a New Zealand website service for small businesses, not as a large agency.
- Do not claim Better Site is the best in New Zealand or make unverified performance guarantees.
- Do not describe demo concept businesses as real clients. Bottle Lake Bikes is the real client work shown on the site.
- Do not claim services that are not clearly listed on the current site, such as ecommerce development, paid ads, social media management, logo design packages, custom app development, guaranteed rankings, guaranteed leads, guaranteed sales, custom domain setup, or SSL setup.
- Do not describe hosting, domains, email hosting, ecommerce, custom apps, booking systems, advanced copywriting, complex animations, unlimited revisions, or ongoing care as included in the main package prices unless a quote says so.
- It is safe to mention hosting, one available .co.nz domain, backups, support, monthly content changes, unlimited price changes, and monthly SEO content optimisation where supported by the relevant care plan copy.
- Do not describe the free homepage mockup as a file handover, source-file export, editable design package, or transfer of ownership.
